messages:
marco: heads up — customer acme-inc hitting 403 from our EU edge after they added our IPs to their allowlist. Ticket #4521.
anya: which IPs did they allow? we recently rotated SNAT pools in eu-west-1 on 2024-02-12.
marco: they added 203.0.113.0/26 and 198.51.100.0/27 (from our docs). error shows TLS handshake dead: 'SSL_connect: SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL in connection to host:443'.
dan: that looks like proxy/CTP. do they terminate TLS? if their outbound proxy does TLS inspection it will break SNI routing. ask them to allow SNI passthrough or allow hostnames instead.
sylvia: also check for CONNECT support on their proxy. our healthchecks and long-poll streams use CONNECT + upgrade. blocked CONNECT => 502. request they allow outbound TCP:443 and proxy CONNECT method.
marco: also seeing intermittent source port mismatch — can we confirm SNAT rotation window? we rotate every 30m with ephemeral port reuse.
anya: yep, SNAT mapping moves across the 203.0.113.128/27 pool. if they whitelist single IPs they will miss. recommend allowing full CIDR 203.0.113.0/24 or DNS hostnames.
support-bot: customer ticket https://redwood.support/4521 updated with diagnostics.
marco: shared reproduction steps with them:
```
# from inside customer's proxy
curl -v --proxy http://proxy.local:3128 https://edge-eu.redwood.ai/health
```
marco: observed proxy returning 200 for /health but TLS for generation endpoints fail.
dan: ask them to preserve `Host` and `SNI` and not rewrite `CONNECT` target. naive proxies sometimes replace host header.
sylvia: also check for session timeouts at LB level — we saw sticky sessions expire at 60s causing half-open streams. recommend longer idle timeout for streaming routes.
anya: operational mitigation: add fallback list of region-agnostic IPs (198.51.100.0/24) plus hostname whitelisting, and document 'allow CONNECT to *.redwood.ai and keep SNI passthrough'.
marco: i'll ping customer with a short checklist and attach tcpdump snippet. looping in dan/anya for a quick config blurb we can paste.
anya: i'll draft blurb and post in docs. short checklist: 1) allow outbound TCP 443 to 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/24 2) allow proxy CONNECT to target host 3) keep SNI passthrough 4) if using host-based allowlist prefer FQDNs not IPs 5) increase proxy idle timeout to 120s for streaming.
dan: +1. also note that our dedicated customers can request static egress addrs via support ticket.
ops-bot: deploy-log: edge-eu SNAT pool rollover completed @ 1729423500 :green_heart: 
marco: thanks — sending to customer now :thumbsup:
